title: Equivariant linear fibre isomorphisms lift to finite locally constant module sheaves
statement: For a scheme T, a monodromy point p and its specified Galois finite correspondence, let F and G be valuation-ring module sheaves whose underlying set sheaves are finite locally constant. Every linear isomorphism between their actual geometric stalks that intertwines evaluation of the specified fundamental-group action lifts uniquely to an isomorphism of module sheaves whose stalk is exactly that isomorphism. No finiteness of the coefficient ring is assumed. Definitions and hypotheses are those of [def-sfb-monodromy-realization-data].

proof.text: Transport the equivariant fibre map through the specified finite-etale/FLC equivalence. The finite-etale fundamental-group equivalence lifts it to a map of finite locally constant set sheaves; its fibre formula follows from the correspondence evaluation and counit naturality.

Addition is a map from the square of the underlying finite locally constant sheaf, and each scalar multiplication is an endomorphism. Their stalk formulas and faithfulness force the lifted map to preserve both operations. Apply the same argument to the inverse; faithfulness proves the inverse identities and uniqueness. Germ surjectivity verifies the operation formulas, so the argument applies to arbitrary coefficient rings and to zero modules. The faithful stalk and equality-detection helpers are reused from Sheaf.Paper.LatticeNormalizationRationalExact, where their unchanged proofs transport the given finite correspondence; its rational-exactness theorem is not used.

theorem finite_fibre_linear_lifting (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type (u + 1)) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (p : SfMonodromyPoint T)
    (c : GaloisLisseFiniteCorrespondence p.point p.group)
    (F G : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)))
    (hF : IsLisseEtaleSheafOfSets (galoisUnderlyingSetSheaf _ F))
    (hG : IsLisseEtaleSheafOfSets (galoisUnderlyingSetSheaf _ G))
    (e : (((pointSmallEtale p.point).sheafFiber
      (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))).obj F)
      ≃ₗ[Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E]
      (((pointSmallEtale p.point).sheafFiber
        (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))).obj G))
    (he : ∀ (g : p.group) (x y : ((pointSmallEtale p.point).sheafFiber
        (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))).obj F),
      sfModuleFiberToSet l E p F y =
        (c.γ g).hom.app (galoisUnderlyingFLC _ F hF) (sfModuleFiberToSet l E p F x) →
      sfModuleFiberToSet l E p G (e y) =
        (c.γ g).hom.app (galoisUnderlyingFLC _ G hG)
          (sfModuleFiberToSet l E p G (e x))) :
    ∃! d : F ≅ G,
      ((pointSmallEtale p.point).sheafFiber
        (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))).mapIso d =
          e.toModuleIso
